title: The Folly of Certainty
summary:
However, not slowing the economy would have brought
the risk that inflationary psychology might take hold in those three to four years, necessitating even
stronger action. This is the memo by Howard Marks, The Folly of Certainty. The impetus for my memos can come from a wide variety of sources.
